model.title: Who pays for what, and why.

pricing.title: How a price is built.
pricing.lead: Structure first: stacking tiers, clear rules and discounts in an order you can explain.

funnel.title: The journey, stage by stage.

loop.title: What brings people back.
loop.lead: Each loop is a concrete product sequence: what happens, in what order and who takes the next step.

sale.title: How I sell: demo first.
sale.lead: The client sees their business running before we talk price. Then a written proposal and a cleared payment.

first.title: The first number on every dashboard.
first.lead: Every dashboard opens with a deliberately chosen number, plus a rule on what counts and what waits.

eclipse.decision: Everything is a monthly plan, with setup included. Work starts with the first cleared payment.

lucero.decision: Zero commission per order: the venue pays a subscription and every order is charged in full at its till.

volta.decision: Resells brands and adds its own. It earns the price minus landed cost: supplier plus packaging.

velmar.decision: Every product has its recipe: materials, machine minutes and hand minutes. The suggested price comes from there.

dentalos.decision: Every campaign is judged by contribution: how many visits cover its cost, before it goes out.

subtotal.d: Each variant's list price times its quantity.

packOrStack.d: Full pack: 10 %, plus 5 % more each month. Stack: 10 % with three categories. One or the other.

coupon.d: Percentage, fixed amount with a minimum, or free shipping; one per purchase.

transfer.d: 10 % on what remains, with a receipt the owner approves.

shipping.d: Free above a threshold, measured on the subtotal.

giftcard.d: The balance pays for products and shipping; it expires after 12 months.

velmar.title: What should a made-to-order piece sell for?
velmar.rule: Margin is measured on the sale price, and the price rounds up to the next 100 pesos.

volta.title: Which price delivers the target margin?
volta.rule: The proposed price always rounds up, so it keeps at least the target margin.

dentalos.title: How many visits cover a campaign?
dentalos.none: With zero or negative contribution, the campaign is judged on continuity of care.
dentalos.rule: Contribution is net revenue minus variable costs, which is different from profit. The response is an assumption.
